preconditions.description: The number of elements n is between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.
The number of constraints m is between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= l <= r <= n and 0 <= q < 2**30 for l, r, q in constraints)
preconditions.description: Each constraint (l, r, q) satisfies 1 <= l <= r <= n and 0 <= q < 2^30.

postconditions.expression: is_yes and (all(0 <= x < 2**30 for x in result_array) and all(all((result_array[l-1] & result_array[r-1]) == q for l, r, q in constraints) for l, r, q in constraints))
postconditions.description: If output is YES, the printed array contains n non-negative integers less than 2^30, and for every constraint (l, r, q), the bitwise AND of elements from index l to r equals q.
If output is NO, no array of n non-negative integers exists that satisfies all given constraints.
The output must be either YES followed by a valid array, or NO alone.
